title: Four seasons over one block
note: Seamless 12 s social loop, 9:16. Picture: Blender Cutaway kit (films/styles/cutaway), blender.py + szworld.py + szmats.py here; the year itself loops (spring on both sides of the seam), all motion repeats on 12 s, the camera sways 3 degrees on a 12 s sine, so frame 287 flows into frame 0.
